gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-oxygen: Cosmic, stencil-cut, and unhurried: Galaxy spaces its letters out loosely. Oxygen, a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, lets text run line after line without ever snagging.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-preahvihear: Galaxy draws every letter with one uninterrupted line width. Preahvihear brings a lofty x-height plus wide-mouthed letters, so the sans body holds its own beside that hairline-free, swell-free heading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-prompt: Prompt has an oversized look to its small letters. Galaxy's t has a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and that commanding heading meets a plain sans whose open apertures stay readable.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-radio-canada-big: Galaxy lays down cosmic, commanding letters of uninterrupted line width, spaced loosely and standing tall in the lowercase. Radio Canada Big, a sans-serif, fills the line with monoline strokes.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sarpanch: Cosmic and loose, Galaxy takes its time. Sarpanch, a sans with a clearly open lowercase e and a compact gap up to the ascender line, keeps the text tidy underneath.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Galaxy looks drawn with a single pen tip, every letter holding one uninterrupted line width. Schibsted Grotesk, a plain sans with tall open bowls, keeps paragraphs inviting from first line to last.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sintony: The body reads smooth, with a chunky, tall midzone and no clogged curves, under Galaxy's commanding display lettering. Sintony, a plain sans, carries paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Commanding from the first letter, Galaxy holds one uninterrupted line width across every stroke and spaces its letters loosely. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, with its near-capital-height lowercase, reads cleanly.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline brings wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, plus a deep middle band and a monoline skeleton. Beside Galaxy's loose cosmic lettering, that plain sans stays crisp.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads like rod stock, with curves you can see into and a big-bodied feel in lowercase words. Galaxy supplies the commanding, loosely spaced display lettering up top.
